notes: Context-creation requestTiming opt-in; immediate immutable snapshot with Option epoch-millisecond origin and Option millisecond offsets. Original retained instance and live owners required. Successful-only responseEnd; backend header boundaries differ. Missing origins/phases, TLS and uncollected worker timings stay unavailable; stock WebKit redirects lack native origins. No terminal wait or retroactive collection.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Optional browser features do work only when requested, within the owning context or operation.
